name: Blackbeard's Castle
scope: Blackbeard’s Castle, the Skytsborg watchtower on Government Hill, in its early twentieth-century appearance around the 1918 postcard. Includes the tapered rubble-masonry tower, north entry and historical wooden observatory on the parapet.

originalReview.notes: The 1918 Curt Teich halftone gives the weathered masonry, arched north entrance, radial slit rows, parapet and dark wooden observatory under a shallow faceted roof. Printed tint is approximate evidence of color.
The circa-1915 divided-back print corroborates the tapered wall, tiered openings and roofed observatory. The separate foreground windmill and nearby buildings are outside the selected tower.

review.method: Two exact early twentieth-century Qualla postcards with native expiry evidence
review.notes: Reviewed and selected the two exact published Qualla postcard scans. Native records identify Waldrop’s 1918 Chicago-printed postcard and the circa-1915 Taylor print, both with explicit expiry grants. The wooden observatory shown in both is also documented in the NPS record. No supplemental imagery was used.
